title: The missing ceiling of the metacyclic bracket
content: The parent chain bounds |Gal(Xⁿ−p/ℚ)| by a two-sided bracket: lower factors n ∣ |Gal| and φ(n) ∣ |Gal| (combining to n·φ(n) ∣ |Gal| when gcd(n,φ(n)) = 1), against the symmetric-group upper bound |Gal| ∣ n!. The squeeze pins the order only when n·φ(n) = n!, i.e. only at n = 2, 3. For n ≥ 4 the factorial bound is loose (n·φ(n) < n!), leaving the order unpinned. This file supplies the sharp metacyclic ceiling |Gal| ≤ n·φ(n) — unconditionally — via the radical tower ℚ ⊆ ℚ(ζₙ) ⊆ ℚ(ζₙ)(ⁿ√p) = L, the conjectured order n·φ(n) being the order of the holomorph ℤ/n ⋊ (ℤ/n)ˣ.

title: One radical and one root of unity generate the splitting field
content: The heart of the bound: L = ℚ(ζₙ, α) for a single root α and primitive n-th root ζ. Every root β of Xⁿ−p satisfies βⁿ = p = αⁿ, so (β/α)ⁿ = 1; since ζ is primitive, IsPrimitiveRoot.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one gives β/α = ζⁱ, hence β = ζⁱ·α ∈ ℚ(ζ,α). As the roots generate L (IsSplittingField.adjoin_rootSet) and each lies in ℚ(ζ,α), the relative adjoin ℚ(ζ)(α) — collapsed to the absolute ℚ(ζ,α) by adjoin_adjoin_left — equals ⊤. This is exactly what caps the upper tower factor at n rather than n!: the splitting field needs only two generators, not all n roots independently.

title: Multiplying the tower degrees: φ(n) · n
content: With L = ℚ(ζ)(α), the tower law Module.finrank_mul_finrank gives [L:ℚ] = [ℚ(ζ):ℚ]·[L:ℚ(ζ)]. The bottom factor is [ℚ(ζ):ℚ] = deg(Φₙ) = φ(n) (adjoin.finrank with the cyclotomic minimal polynomial). The top factor is [L:ℚ(ζ)] = (minpoly_{ℚ(ζ)} α).natDegree ≤ n, because α is a root of the degree-n polynomial Xⁿ − p already over ℚ(ζ) (minpoly.dvd, then natDegree_le_of_dvd against the nonzero Xⁿ−C p). Hence |Gal| = [L:ℚ] ≤ φ(n)·n = n·φ(n) — the metacyclic ceiling, strictly sharper than n! whenever n ≥ 4.

title: Ceiling meets floor: exact order at coprime degrees
content: gal_card_eq_n_mul_totient_of_coprime closes the squeeze: when gcd(n, φ(n)) = 1, the parent's coprime lower bound n·φ(n) ∣ |Gal| (mul_totient_dvd_gal_card_of_coprime) forces n·φ(n) ≤ |Gal| (Nat.le_of_dvd, |Gal| > 0), while this entry's ceiling gives |Gal| ≤ n·φ(n); Nat.le_antisymm pins |Gal| = n·φ(n) exactly. Crucially this needs no genericity hypothesis and works at every coprime degree — including n ≥ 4 where the parent's factorial squeeze (which required n·φ(n) = n!) fails.

title: |Gal(X⁵−p)| = 20 = |F₂₀| for every prime p
content: The headline instance: gal_card_quintic_eq_twenty pins |Gal(X⁵−p/ℚ)| = 20 = |AGL(1,5)| = |F₂₀|, uniformly in the prime p. Here gcd(5, φ(5)) = gcd(5,4) = 1, so the coprime bracket applies: 5·φ(5) = 20 ∣ |Gal| from below, |Gal| ≤ 20 from the ceiling. The symmetric-group bound alone is powerless — it only gives |Gal| ∣ 5! = 120, leaving 20, 40, 60, 120 all open — so the cyclotomic ceiling is essential. This is the first genuinely-new exact pin beyond the parent's n = 2, 3 factorial squeeze, exhibiting the Frobenius affine group F₂₀ as the quintic radical Galois group. The two `decide` calls evaluate Nat.Coprime 5 (φ 5) and 5·φ(5) = 20 by kernel reduction (no native_decide).
